wishlist.title: JACK REACHER / LEE CHILD
wishlist.subtitle: Especially Killing Floor or any gripping Reacher paperback.
wishlist.description: Paperback preferred for comfortable reading during quiet hours.

wishlist.title: GUITAR TUNER
wishlist.subtitle: Clip-on acoustic/electric chromatic tuner (e.g. Snark, TC Electronic, Boss).
wishlist.description: Keep the riffs in tune without disturbing the neighbours.

wishlist.title: EDC / FOLDING KNIFE
wishlist.subtitle: Classy pocket knife (Opinel No. 8, Victorinox Swiss Army, or sleek EDC folder).
wishlist.description: Essential gentleman everyday carry for opening packages and artisanal cheese.

wishlist.title: KNIFE SHARPENING GEAR
wishlist.subtitle: Whetstone (1000/6000 grit), leather strop, or ceramic honing rod.
wishlist.description: For that razor-sharp satisfying edge maintenance.

wishlist.title: PUZZLES & BRAIN TEASERS
wishlist.subtitle: Cast metal Hanayama puzzle, wooden Japanese secret puzzle box, or mechanical teaser.
wishlist.description: Tactile mental gymnastics while pretending to listen on Zoom calls.

wishlist.title: DISCREET NOVELTY / ADULT ACCESSORIES
wishlist.subtitle: Tasteful, cheeky, adult-appropriate intrigue. Surprise Daddy responsibly.

wishlist.title: BOOK — SURPRISE ME
wishlist.subtitle: History, biography, philosophy, espionage, or grim darkly funny fiction.
wishlist.description: Feed Daddy’s voracious curiosity with a thoughtful, unexpected read.

wishlist.title: SURPRISE DADDY
wishlist.subtitle: Whisky miniature, fine ground coffee beans, or something completely absurd.
wishlist.description: Let your creativity run wild with something memorable.
